description: Hack-a-Sol 5.0 is the fifth edition of IIIT Naya Raipur’s flagship national-level hackathon, bringing together passionate innovators, developers, and problem-solvers from across the country for an intensive 36-hour innovation marathon . Participants will collaborate, ideate, and develop impactful solutions to real-world challenges, exploring emerging technologies and domains such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, Web Development, Sustainability, and more. Event Details: Dates: 22nd – 24th November 2026 Venue: IIIT Naya Raipur Duration: 36 Hours Team Size: 2 to 4 members Why Participate? Gain valuable insights and guidance from industry experts, mentors, and technology professionals. Showcase your technical skills and compete with talented innovators from across India. Collaborate with like-minded individuals and transform innovative ideas into working solutions. Experience an intensive environment of creativity, teamwork, problem-solving, and innovation. Expand your network and push the boundaries of your technical potential. Who Can Participate? Hack-a-Sol 5.0 welcomes students, developers, designers, and aspiring innovators from colleges and universities across India who are passionate about technology, innovation, and building solutions that make a difference.
organiser: International Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Naya Raipur
